context: A retired exec coaches a younger boss through a stalemate
purpose: Teach: 討議/必見/共演/頂ける/平行/引き起こす/なおかつ/対等

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 事前討議の段階で双方の譲れない一線を整理しておかないと、本番でまた揉めるぞ。
lines.en: If you don't sort out each side's bottom lines during the preliminary discussions, you'll clash again at the main meeting.
lines.style: Calm elder mentor speaking with measured authority and warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それは分かっているんですが、議論が平行線のまま三週間も止まっていて、正直手詰まりです。
lines.en: I understand, but the discussion has run parallel for three weeks now, and honestly I'm stuck.
lines.style: Younger boss, frustrated but respectful, voice slightly tense.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 焦って強行すれば、社内に新たな対立を引き起こすだけだ。まずは相手を対等な交渉相手として扱いなさい。
lines.en: Forcing it through in a panic will only spark fresh internal conflict. First, treat them as an equal negotiating partner.
lines.style: Steady, paternal tone, delivering hard advice gently and firmly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 対等に、ですか…正直、こちらが譲歩ばかりしている気がして、納得できないんです。
lines.en: As equals... honestly, it feels like we've been the only ones conceding, and I can't accept that.
lines.style: Pushback delivered carefully, mixing pride with private doubt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 譲歩と敗北は別物だ。手軽でなおかつ確実な一手として、今週は聞き役に徹してみないか。
lines.en: Concession and defeat are different things. As a light yet reliable move, why not commit to just listening this week?
lines.style: Wise reframing, slow and deliberate cadence with light humor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 聞き役…ですか。それで先方の本音を聞かせて頂けるなら、試してみる価値はありそうです。
lines.en: Just listening, huh. If that lets us hear their real thoughts, it might be worth a try.
lines.style: Cautious agreement, voice softening as he reconsiders the approach.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それから、社外の第三者を一人挟むといい。信頼できる調停役との共演があれば、空気が一気に変わる。
lines.en: And bring in one outside third party. With a trusted mediator working alongside you, the atmosphere shifts immediately.
lines.style: Practical strategy, confident from decades of boardroom experience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど、来週の取締役会の前に、必見の論点を一度すべて洗い出してみます。早速、人選も進めますね。
lines.en: I see — before next week's board session, I'll lay out every must-review point at least once. I'll start choosing candidates too.
lines.style: Renewed resolve, energized and noticeably more focused now.
